socios: Heading of the sidebar group listing the person's socios (AI agents). "socio" is the product's word for an AI agent; keep it lowercase as a common noun.
create-socio: Tooltip and accessible name of the + button beside the Socios heading; it creates a new socio (AI agent).
dot.tooltip: Tooltip of a socio in the collapsed sidebar: {{name}} is the socio's name. The plain form is for a workspace socio (shared with the team); _personal for one only its owner uses.
dot.title: Hover text of a socio's sidebar row: who can see and use it. The plain form is for a workspace (team-wide) socio; _personal for one only the signed-in person uses.
dot.options: Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens a socio's menu; {{name}} is the socio's name.
recent: Heading of the sidebar group listing the person's latest chats.
new-chat: Tooltip and accessible name of the + button beside Recent chats; it starts a new conversation.
setup: Shown in the sidebar while text chat isn't set up on this server (no model configured).
empty: Shown in the sidebar before the person has any conversation.
show-fewer: Button under the recent chats that folds the list back to the first few.
show-all: Button under the recent chats that lists all of them; count is how many there are (always more than 5).
team: After a chat's socio name in the sidebar ("Ada · Team"): the chat is a team conversation, shared with other people.
chat-options: Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens a chat's menu; {{title}} is the chat's title.
icon.team: Accessible name of the icon marking a team conversation (shared with other people).
icon.telegram: Accessible name of the icon marking a conversation that takes place in Telegram (the messaging app; don't translate the name).
loading.paused: Under the socio's (AI agent's) name while the chat loads: an admin paused Socio (the product).
loading.connecting: Under the socio's (AI agent's) name while the chat loads.
